Hi all,

Thanks Marissa - looping in David for infra details. Quick answers and attachments to share with Medwise:

1) SOC 2: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II as of Q1 2027. Attached is the redacted SOC 2 report (Redwood_SOC2_Report_Q1_2027.pdf).

2) HIPAA-eligible deployment modes (short):
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pools) - SUPPORTED for PHI. Strong isolation: customer-dedicated nodes, optional VPC peering, and customer-managed KMS available for encryption at rest. Recommended default for most enterprise PHI workloads.
- Private (on-prem / air-gapped) - SUPPORTED for PHI. Full control; ideal for regulated customers who need local control of keys and network.
- Hosted API (redwood-hosted multi-tenant) - NOT ELIGIBLE for PHI. We do offer KMS integration for Hosted for key separation, but Hosted remains non-PHI by policy.

3) PHI handling guarantees:
- No training on customer data: customer data is never used to train or fine-tune models.
- KV cache and prefix caching: can be scoped to Dedicated/Private clusters; PHI routes can be configured to disable caching if requested.
- Token logging: for PHI routes we can disable token-level logs and only emit high-level audit events; retention configurable per contract and BAA.

4) Encryption & KMS:
- In transit: TLS 1.2+/mTLS options for Dedicated and Private.
- At rest: AES-256 with customer-managed keys via supported KMS providers for Dedicated and Private. Hosted supports customer KMS for some metadata but not sufficient for PHI compliance.

5) Onboarding timeline:
- Dedicated: typical 4-6 weeks (provisioning, network peering, security review). We can often accelerate to 2-3 weeks with prioritized infra and a signed SOW.
- Private: depends on customer infra; plan for 6-12 weeks.

6) Next steps for Medwise:
- Please return the completed vendor security questionnaire (Medwise_Vendor_Sec_Questionnaire.xlsx).
- Legal: review and redline the BAA (Draft_BAA_Redwood_Medwise.docx). We can accept DocuSign once redlines are resolved (DocuSign link placeholder: https://www.docusign.com/mock/ds12345).
- If you want, we can set a 30-45 minute technical call (Neha + David) to walk their infra/security team through Dedicated architecture and KMS options.

I'll attach the SOC 2 PDF and a one-page HIPAA FAQ for sales use.

Best,
